programs.name: PHFA K-FIT (Keystone Forgivable in Ten Years)

amount.text: 5% of the lesser of the purchase price or appraised value, no maximum dollar limit

programs.repayment: forgiven 10% a year over ten years; no monthly payment
programs.firstTimeNote: first-time buyer rules follow the PHFA first mortgage it is paired with (the Keystone Home Loan requires no ownership of a principal residence in the previous three years)

incomeLimit.text: Keystone Home Loan income and purchase price limits by county (PHFA Appendix A)

programs.quote: Eligible borrowers may receive five percent (5%) of the lesser of the purchase price or appraised value with no maximum dollar limit in downpayment and closing cost assistance. The K-FIT loan is forgiven on an annual basis over ten years at a rate of ten percent (10%) a year.
programs.note: phfa.org refuses scripted connections; terms taken from the official pages' indexed text

programs.name: PHFA Keystone Advantage Assistance Loan

amount.text: 4% of the purchase price or market value, or $6,000, whichever is less

programs.repayment: second mortgage at 0% interest repaid monthly over ten years
programs.assetLimit: liquid assets may not exceed $50,000 after funds needed to close
programs.quote: Qualified borrowers can receive up to four percent (4%) of the purchase price or market value or $6,000 (whichever is less) in downpayment and closing cost assistance to be repaid monthly.
